summary: Frontend regression test after reorganization + copy overhaul. All 8 requested checks PASS: section order (all sections present and in correct visual order), WeFilmIt (4 images load, caption present), Comparison (5 X items + 5 check items, CHERRYTREE header), System Flow (7 nodes Content→Ads→Landing Page→CRM→Follow-Up→Appointment→Sale, stacks vertically on mobile), Process (6 numbered cards, 3-col on desktop), CTA copy (0 'Book Your Strategy Call' occurrences, 8 'Apply To Work With Cherrytree'), Full form flow (both webhooks fire successfully — form webhook on step 2 continue and appointment webhook on submit, success heading 'Application received', video element with data-testid='success-video' visible with poster and toggles state on click), Mobile 375px (film-strip 2-col, comparison stacks, process stacks, system-flow column, no horizontal overflow). No console errors. Note: two sections use existing testids 'testimonials-section' and 'who-section' (rather than the review-request names 'video-testimonials-section' / 'who-this-is-for-section') — both sections render correctly in the right position; treated as a testid-naming note, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoTestimonials.jsx uses data-testid='testimonials-section' and WhoThisIsFor.jsx uses 'who-section' — the review request references 'video-testimonials-section' and 'who-this-is-for-section'. Sections work fine; consider aligning testid names if downstream tests expect the request-side names.
AppointmentForm.jsx REVENUE array lists 'Under $1M' last which is an odd ordering (mixes ascending brackets then an under-floor entry at the end). Minor UX polish.
ProcessTimeline.jsx: on mobile widths <640px cards render single-column (not stacked 2x3); spec asked for '3x2 grid on desktop' which is satisfied via lg:grid-cols-3.
seed_data_creation: Two live webhook POSTs to production LeadConnector URLs were sent with TEST_ prefixed data (owner_name='TEST User', company_name='TEST Co', email='test@example.com'). Consider cleaning these leads in GHL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All reorganization checks pass. Webhooks are live (real GHL endpoints), so E2E form testing creates real leads — flag TEST_ entries to the operator. Confirmation video: automation browsers can't play H.264, so verify poster+DOM toggle only. Testid naming mismatch documented above is not a regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
